boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented campus spaces for collaborative work, quiet study, gathering, and recreation.

cards.title: Set up in the Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the northeast-corner tables or lounge chairs when you want daylight and a setting where individual and collaborative work are both supported.
cards.short_summary: A window-lined first-floor library area built for solo or collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries identifies the Research Commons as a first-floor space with tables and lounge chairs for individual and collaborative work.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor, northeast corner, just off the North Entrance.

cards.title: Work around the Collaboration Hub
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library, first floor
cards.notes: Bring a small group to the northwest corner for tables, study nooks, mobile monitors, whiteboards, and nearby group or videoconference rooms.
cards.short_summary: A flexible library hub with shared work surfaces and collaboration tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries lists tables, study nooks, group rooms, videoconference rooms, mobile monitors, and whiteboards in the Collaboration Hub.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor northwest corner, just off the North Entrance.

cards.title: Take a table in Scholars Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library concourse
cards.notes: Choose a large table for a collaborative session, or use the smaller tables and lounge seating for a quieter individual study break.
cards.short_summary: A concourse lounge that supports both table work and casual conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries says Mahaffey Scholars Lounge offers large collaborative tables, individual tables, couches, and lounge chairs.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Hesburgh Library concourse across from Au Bon Pain.

cards.title: Choose the lower level for quiet work
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library, lower level
cards.notes: Use the booths, tables, or lounge chairs when you need focused reading or individual work; the library describes this area as typically low-noise.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level seating area intended for focused, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries describes Lower Level Study Seats as low-noise space with booths, tables, lounge chairs, and quiet-study use.
cards.access_notes: Use the Hesburgh Library lower-level floor map for the current location and layout.

cards.title: Book a first-floor group room
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library Collaboration Hub
cards.notes: Reserve a room for two or more people when you need a whiteboard and focused group space; unreserved non-multimedia rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Collaboration Hub rooms for small-group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries states its group study rooms are reservable for collaborative work and, when unreserved, generally first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms Reservation Policy | Hesburgh Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-floor rooms are in the northwest corner of the Collaboration Hub; reservations have participation and time-limit requirements.

cards.title: Meet beneath the library mural
cards.subtitle: Outside Hesburgh Library
cards.notes: Use the outdoor benches, bistro tables, and chairs beneath Word of Life for an informal meeting or alternative study session near library collections.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor library courtyard with seating for studying and meeting.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries describes Carey Courtyard as an outdoor seating area that became an alternative study and meeting space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space at the Hesburgh Library entrance; use weather-appropriate judgment.

cards.title: Use LaFortune as a campus base
cards.subtitle: Central campus student center
cards.notes: Stop in to meet, eat, study, or connect with student organizations; Student Activities identifies LaFortune among its campus spaces for these uses.
cards.short_summary: A central student center with organizational and administrative offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame Student Activities says LaFortune Student Center offers space to gather, eat, perform, meet, and study.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Office | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: LaFortune also houses departmental, organizational, and administrative offices; follow current building access rules.

cards.entity_name: Jan and Marty Hiller Midfield Commons
cards.title: Gather in Midfield Commons
cards.subtitle: Duncan Student Center, first and second floors
cards.notes: Use the commons’ open seating for presentations, game watches, or non-ticketed events; it remains designated public space during daily building operations.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level Duncan gathering space with seating and a large video display.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame lists Midfield Commons for presentations, game watches, and non-ticketed events and designates it as public space.
cards.source_title: Meeting Rooms and Event Spaces | Duncan Student Center
cards.access_notes: Reservations and activities are limited so they do not interfere with daily operations; access is subject to building policies.

cards.title: Use the Graduate Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Duncan Student Center, second floor
cards.notes: Graduate and professional students can meet, eat, study, rest, or relax among varied seating; reserve its small conference room for focused group work.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor graduate and professional student lounge with work and break amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame Graduate Student Life describes the Graduate Student Lounge as space for graduate and professional students to meet, eat, study, rest, and relax.
cards.source_title: Grad Lounge in Duncan Student Center | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: On the south side of Duncan’s second floor; the lounge is open when Duncan Student Center is open, and the conference room may be reserved.

cards.title: Move with a group at Rockne
cards.subtitle: South Quad, Dorr Road and Holy Cross Drive
cards.notes: Plan a recreation visit for club sports, intramurals, fitness classes, aquatic instruction, or general recreation after confirming facility hours and eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A South Quad recreation facility with pools, courts, fitness equipment, and club programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Notre Dame RecSports identifies Rockne Memorial as a site for club sports, intramurals, fitness classes, aquatic instruction, and general recreation.
cards.source_title: Rockne Memorial | RecSports | University of Notre Dame
cards.access_notes: RecSports access requires a valid Notre Dame ID for students, faculty, staff, and retirees; confirm current operating hours before visiting.
